## Problem and change

Explain the concrete problem and resulting behavior. Link a related issue if available.

## Validation

List checks actually run and their results. If something was not tested, say so.

- [ ] Relevant unit/browser/build checks passed, or this is documentation-only and links/instructions were checked.
- [ ] English default and Vietnamese support remain intact where affected.
- [ ] No credentials, personal data, signing material, or private deployment configuration are included.
- [ ] Progress/lesson compatibility and account separation were considered where relevant.
- [ ] Any physical-device claims are backed by hardware testing; simulator/mocks are identified as such.

## Risks or follow-up

Mention limitations, migration needs, or hardware/deployment checks still required.
